name: Abundant Energy of Arkansas
old_description: Solar panels produce renewable clean energy while securing low utility rates. Our panels exceed industry standards for durability and lifespan.
about:
Abundant Energy of Arkansas operates from Booneville, Arkansas, serving homeowners across Western Arkansas and Eastern Oklahoma. The company has been in business for over nine years as of 2025, though a specific founding year is not publicly disclosed. Ownership structure and founder names have not been shared publicly.

The firm specializes in solar photovoltaic installation, offering grid-tied and off-grid systems, as well as wind energy solutions. It is the only factory-authorized dealer for LG ESS battery storage systems in Western Arkansas. Services include custom system design, permitting, installation by licensed electricians, and post-installation inspection by utility engineers. The company also provides maintenance and repair for existing arrays, including those installed by competitors, and sells complete solar kits for do-it-yourself homeowners. Staff experience totals more than 30 years combined.

Primary customers are residential property owners seeking to reduce utility costs or achieve energy independence in remote locations where grid extension is impractical. The company also serves DIY enthusiasts who prefer to self-install using supplied kits. Its service territory spans Western Arkansas and Eastern Oklahoma.

Abundant Energy emphasizes customer education about solar operation, competitive pricing, and reliable repair service for storm damage or system failure. Its stated differentiators include exclusive LG ESS authorization in the region, a willingness to service competitor-installed systems, and a focus on off-grid solutions that eliminate the need for net-metering agreements.
